positions.title: Women in Computer Science: Vice President
positions.description: Responsible for planning and running all meetings with our President. Heavily involved in bringing unique experiences to our members such as scholarships to attend conferences, professor-led workshops, and networking/recruiting sessions with companies and other women in technology organizations.

positions.title: Stevens Women's Club Soccer: President
positions.description: Acted as team captain for 3 seasons. Responsible for scheduling games/practices, overall budget, and membership.

positions.title: Women in Computer Science: Public Relations Chair
positions.description: Responsible for the organization's advertising and social media presence. Designed posters to advertise our events and posted them to our social media accounts. Aided in planning/running numerous meetings every semester and had a substantial role in increasing our attendance and membership during the pandemic.

positions.title: Software Development and Coding Intern
positions.description: I spent 10 weeks as a software development and coding intern working with the Marketing Technology (MarTech) team. I was able to learn the basics of several products in the Adobe Marketing Cloud including Adobe Experience Manager, Adobe Target, Adobe Launch, and Adobe Marketo Engage. I was responsible for shouldering a proof of concept pertaining to how the technologies Adobe Experience Manager and Adobe Marketo Engage could be used together and I was able to build a servlet to connect the two technologies.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) · HTML · CSS · Java · TypeScript · Marketo

positions.title: Visa Internship Prep Workshop Participant
positions.description: I participated in a 12-week technical internship program hosted by Visa. This gave me the opportunity to take an Advanced Software Engineering Technical Interview course hosted by Codepath, which I received a certificate for successfully completing.  I was also able to learn more about the internship program at Visa, network with Visa employees and other program participants, and took part in multiple mock interviews.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Data Structures · Algorithms

positions.title: Global Technology Intern
positions.description:
I spent 10 weeks as a remote Global Technology Intern through Prudential’s Sophomore Inclusion Program (SIP). Through this program, I was able to join a NoSQL database team and an API proxy team for 5 weeks, completing projects for each. I was also given the opportunity to participate in a 10-week agile project with 5 other SIP interns. 

While on the NoSQL team, I researched the AWS databases DynamoDB and DocumentDB and presented a comparative analysis to 40+ employees about which would be best to migrate to from MongoDB. During this rotation, I was also able to receive a certification in the basics of MongoDB.

While on the API proxy team, I wrote programs in Java to aid the inputting and storing of data used for certificate mapping for the API proxy Google Apigee. I was also able to learn the basics of APIs and layer 7 protocols.

Finally, as a member of the Sophomore Inclusion Program, I completed a 10-week agile project about the work/life balance of Prudential employees with 5 other SIP interns. Using R, I performed a quantitative analysis and created visuals on the data we collected and presented my findings to over 100 Prudential employees.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon DocumentDB · Agile Methodologies · Java · R · Amazon Dynamodb · Microsoft Excel · MongoDB · R

honors.title: Senior Design Award for Computer Science
honors.description:
This award is presented to the best senior design project in the Department of Computer Science. 

My team won for our project titled "Digital Twins for 5G Security".
